variantDefinitions.vector_only: Chroma cosine retrieval, raw vector ranking, top4; no BM25 or local rerank
variantDefinitions.vector_rerank: Vector top16 only, normalized vector weight=1, BM25 absent, same local lexical rerank
variantDefinitions.hybrid_no_rerank: Vector top16 union BM25 top16, existing 0.65/0.35 fusion, top4 without rerank
variantDefinitions.hybrid_current: Unmodified KnowledgeService.retrieve(mode=hybrid, expand=False), including existing local lexical rerank

limitations: 52 synthetic known engineering queries; metrics averaged over 44 answerable queries only.
Qrels are not exhaustive or independently expert annotated.
Existing real embeddings are replayed, with real Chroma retrieval and existing scoring code rerun; no live embedding API calls.
Small corpus; no large-scale ANN performance claim. No generation or RAGAS evaluation.
No neighbor expansion, matching the existing retrieval evaluation. Local replay times do not measure online latency.

vector_only.unanswerableNote: Retrieval emptiness only; answer abstention/quality is a separate evaluation.
